4.1. Corpus and Metrics The sentiment polarity classiﬁcation task is set as a three-class problem: positive, negative and neutral. The metrics used to measure performance is macro-fmeasure. We developed our system on French and apply the same components on Italian, Spanish and German. A concise description of the training data follows. The French (FR) corpus comes from the DEFT’15 evalu- ation campaign 1. It consists of 7,836 tweets for training and 3,381 tweets for testing.
